text: Requisitos de admisión: Graduación de secundaria o superior; expedientes certificados de cursos de nivel A, IB o AP. Nuevos HSK 4≥180 (para personas no chinas) o aprobar el examen de ingreso de chino de SHUTCM. Los solicitantes que emigraron de China continental, Hong Kong, Macao oISTA must hold valid foreign citizenship for no less than 4 years and a record of residency in the country for no less than 2 years in the most recent 4 years (Before April 30, 2025). (Actual residency for 9 months can be counted as one year based on entry and exit stamps). 16-65 years old.
